title: Experience: We found a baby on the subway – now he's our 26-year-old son
summary: This is a human interest article from The Guardian about a couple who found an abandoned baby on the subway and subsequently adopted him, now sharing their experience 26 years later as they reflect on their family journey together.
problem_solved: This is not a technology-related article; it's a personal narrative/family story about adoption.
why_valuable: Provides emotional storytelling and insight into unconventional family formation, though not technically valuable in the tech sense.
